key_insight: OrchRM learns a reward model for multi-agent orchestration from self-supervised win-lose comparisons of intermediate execution artifacts, avoiding expensive human labels and sub-agent rollouts.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical way to train and scale LLM-based orchestrators more efficiently, cutting token usage by up to 10x while improving test-time performance.
method: Build win-lose pairs from intermediate artifacts produced during multi-agent runs.
Train a Bradley-Terry reward model at the orchestration level.
Use the learned reward to guide orchestrator training and test-time scaling.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports gains across mathematical reasoning, web QA, and multi-hop reasoning, with up to 8% accuracy improvement and up to 10x lower token usage.
watch_item: Because the method depends on intermediate execution artifacts, its effectiveness may vary with orchestration trace quality and how well those artifacts reflect true task success.
